newsitem.title: USA: Evergreen to sell three radio stations.
newsitem.headline: Evergreen to sell three radio stations.

text.p: Evergreen Media Corp said Tuesday it had entered into definitive agreements to sell three radio stations for a total of $64.1 million cash.

It said it will sell WEJM-FM Chicago to Dontron Inc for $14.8 million; WEJM-AM Chicago to Douglas Broadcasting/Personal Achievement Radio for $7.5 million; and WFLN-FM Philadelphia to Greater Media Radio Inc for $41.8 million.
The company said the sales are in line with the station divestiture and portfolio optimization initiatives being undertaken in connection with the formation of Chancellor Media Corp.
Chancellor Media is the company resulting from a planned merger between Evergreen and Chancellor Broadcasting Co.

When the companies agreed to merge, they agreed to acquire 10 radio properties owned by Viacom Inc and sell stations in markets where the new entity exceeded current U.S. Federal Communications Commission ownership limits.
The transactions are scheduled to close in the third quarter and are subject to FCC approval, Evergreen said.
